_readme: Lamplight — the cast's notification lines. Edit here, save (Commit), and every phone picks it up the next time the game is opened.
RULES (the game refuses the WHOLE file if any one is broken — nothing changes on any phone, and the Developer log in Settings says why):
1. version: a whole number. Raise it by 1 EVERY time you save, or phones ignore the file.
2. who: dolphin, owl or gull. title: 28 characters max. line: 150 characters max. No emoji, no line breaks.
3. daily lines must contain {artist} and {title} — the game fills in the evening's painting.
4. COUNTS: lines and roast must NOT be a multiple of 7 (24 and 15 are fine; 21, 28 are not). daily must be odd and not end in 5 (13, 11, 17 fine; 10, 12, 15 not).
5. lines = the cast's nonsense (every 3rd evening), roast = the dig at the player (every 3rd), daily = the evening painting note (every 3rd).
Check the JSON is valid before saving (a missing comma breaks it): paste it into jsonlint.com.

lines.title: Reported.
lines.line: A visitor finished today’s painting in nine moves. We reported them to the curator.

lines.title: For the record
lines.line: The dolphin told everyone you couldn’t finish the Hokusai. I said nothing. I defended you a little.

lines.title: The Vermeer, again
lines.line: It’s been a while. The Vermeer is starting to ask questions.

lines.title: Bench update
lines.line: The gulls took your bench. I did nothing. It is, however, your bench.

lines.title: It was the dolphin
lines.line: Someone called today’s painting “too easy.” It was the dolphin. It’s always the dolphin.

lines.title: Pigeon situation
lines.line: We’ve started a rumour about the pigeons. We are staying out of it. Come stay out of it with us.

lines.title: He wants a wing
lines.line: The dolphin wants a wing named after him. We’re all being very normal about it.

lines.title: From the night guard
lines.line: The night guard says the paintings look at her. Only the unfinished ones. Just passing that along.

lines.title: I need you to know
lines.line: The dolphin called himself “the talent” in a meeting. There was no meeting. He called one to say it.

lines.title: EMERGENCY (gulls)
lines.line: We have a fry. One fry. There are eleven of us. Come before this becomes a war.

lines.title: Legal update
lines.line: The dolphin has trademarked his own name. The pond has one dolphin. Nobody knows what this achieves.

lines.title: Overheard
lines.line: The dolphin, to a pigeon, at length: “my best friend hasn’t visited.” It was the pigeon’s first day.

lines.title: Since when??
lines.line: My mom knitted me a sweater. Since when does she knit??

lines.title: Is this the end?
lines.line: My kid said some numbers and laughed. Is this the end?

lines.title: I live in the pond now
lines.line: I waved at someone who wasn’t waving at me. I live in the pond now.

lines.title: The fry incident
lines.line: The gulls found a french fry at nine this morning. It’s been a whole thing.

lines.title: “You too.”
lines.line: I said “you too” when the fish said “enjoy your meal.” I’ve thought about it all day.

lines.title: Fridge, twice
lines.line: I opened the fridge, forgot why, closed it, then opened it again out of respect.

lines.title: Six years
lines.line: My neighbour said “we should get coffee sometime.” That was six years ago. I think about it weekly.

lines.title: We both knew
lines.line: I told my dentist I floss. We both knew.

lines.title: Confession
lines.line: I told the fish I was busy tonight. I am not busy tonight. I’m holding the lamp. Come make me honest.

lines.title: The owl has a request
lines.line: I told the night guard you were “a good one.” I have never lied. I am not starting for you. Come.

lines.title: We took a vote
lines.line: Nine gulls say you’re coming tonight. One abstained. He was eating. Come settle it.

lines.title: Nothing is wrong
lines.line: I’m fine. The pond is fine. The lamp is lit. That’s three “fine”s. Please come.

roast.title: Be honest
roast.line: You rotated the same piece four times and called it strategy. I watched. I have nothing else to do.

roast.title: We talked about you
roast.line: We described you to the pigeons as “very confident for someone who checks the picture that much.” They got it.

roast.title: A small observation
roast.line: You hold the phone like the painting owes you money. It doesn’t. Come anyway.

roast.title: Your streak
roast.line: You call it a streak. I call it three days with a gap in the middle. We can both be right. You are less right.

roast.title: Congratulations
roast.line: You finished a painting yesterday and told no one. Correct. There was nothing to tell.

roast.title: Question
roast.line: Do you squint at the picture on purpose, or is that just your face now? Asking for all eleven of us.

roast.title: About the hint button
roast.line: You tapped the hint like it owed you an apology. It’s a button. It has been very patient with you.

roast.title: I’ve seen your moves
roast.line: You solve like someone parallel parking in front of a crowd. It works. It is not pretty. Come do it again.

roast.title: Statement
roast.line: You said “one more” four times last night. We counted. We can’t count. It was still four.

roast.title: Noted
roast.line: You hold your breath on the last piece. Every time. The painting is not going anywhere. You might.

roast.title: Real talk
roast.line: Nine moves is not a personality. I’ve seen your Hokusai. Come try again where I can watch.

roast.title: Reminder
roast.line: You told the owl you “don’t need the picture.” You then looked at the picture nine times. It’s fine. We look too.

roast.title: A theory
roast.line: Nobody rotates a corner piece that many times by accident. I have a theory. Come disprove it.

roast.title: Careful
roast.line: You’re one skipped evening away from the gulls calling you “the former visitor.” They’ve already drafted it.

roast.title: Vote result
roast.line: We ranked the visitors by grace under pressure. You’re fourth. There are four of you. Come improve.

daily.title: The dolphin has notes
daily.line: Tonight it’s {artist} — {title}. He says the corners will get you. Come make him wrong.

daily.title: Owl. Reporting in.
daily.line: {title} is on the easel. {artist}. I’ve been guarding it since four. I am tired. Come.

daily.title: The gulls are ON the easel
daily.line: Tonight: {artist}, {title}. We’ve already stood on it. Someone responsible should finish it.

daily.title: Painting hung. Lamp lit.
daily.line: {artist} — {title}. The dolphin bet me you’d skip it. Don’t let him win. He’s unbearable.

daily.title: It’s a big one tonight
daily.line: {title}, by {artist}. I said it was “fine.” I never say “fine.” Read into that.

daily.title: A situation at the easel
daily.line: We tried to solve {title} ourselves. It went badly. {artist} deserves better than us. Come.

daily.title: The curator asked about you
daily.line: Tonight is {artist} — {title}. We said you were on your way. Please be on your way.

daily.title: I’m not bothered
daily.line: {title} is up. {artist}. I’ve checked the door four times. Not because of you. Come anyway.

daily.title: Owl, quietly
daily.line: {artist} tonight. {title}. I laid the pieces out. Nobody asked me to. I did it anyway.

daily.title: GULL DISPATCH
daily.line: TONIGHT: {title}. {artist}. We’ve eaten nothing since noon from nerves. A lie. Come anyway.

daily.title: The dolphin says it’s easy
daily.line: {artist} — {title}. “The easy one,” he says. He has never finished a single painting. Not one.

daily.title: Someone is waiting
daily.line: {title}, {artist}, on the easel, in the dark, with me. I don’t mind. I mind a little.

daily.title: This is not a drill
daily.line: It is slightly a drill. {artist} — {title} is up and the gulls have been circling since lunch.
